meta.note: Trees as [x, z, kind, osm] (osm 1 = an OpenStreetMap natural=tree point, 0 = synthesised). kind: elm = the American elm allees of the Mall (4 rows each side of the lawn panels) and of the Reflecting Pool / Constitution Gardens; cherry = Yoshino cherries ringing the Tidal Basin (OSM maps only a few hundred of the ~3,700, so two shore rows 5.5 u and 9.5 u from the seawall are filled in); park = in a lawn or garden; street = street trees. Elms inside the ring site (ring.ringClearTrees in dc_layout.json) are left out. Elms 20-25 m (4-5 u) tall with vase-shaped canopies; cherries 6-9 m, broad and low, green in late-morning summer light (pale pink only if a spring look is wanted).
